tara_sales: FYI Acme security needs SIEM ingestion proof + retention numbers + admin activity samples for their SIG/CAIQ review. They want replayable evidence for the POC. Can we get artifacts by EOD Wed? cc @ben_se @omar_security
ben_se: On it. Do they want raw syslog/S3 exports or a Splunk/Datadog ingest example?
omar_security: Recommend we include: admin audit schema, example events (redacted), retention policy (what we commit for hosted vs enterprise), proof of tamper-evidence (sha256 manifest/timestamp). Also a sample SIEM query that demonstrates detecting an admin delete.
claire_enginfra: We have an automated export pipeline -> S3 + Firehose -> Splunk. Can produce a 7-day redacted sample bundle. Example export path: s3://redwood-prod-exports/acme-poc/2026-03-20/

```
{
  "event": "admin.update",
  "user": "alice@acme.com",
  "ts": "2025-11-03T14:22:01Z",
  "action": "policy.change",
  "request_id": "req_abc123"
}
```
omar_security: Retention notes: hosted tenants default to 90 days, enterprise contracts can be 365 or 730 days, private deployments: customer-controlled. We'll include the text we use in the SIG answer. :white_check_mark:
tara_sales: Also they asked for tamper-evidence for audit exports — signed manifest + timestamped object needed. Can we generate that for the sample export?
claire_enginfra: Yes. We can include a SHA256 manifest and S3 object lock/timestamp. Example commands we will provide to customer: 
```
aws s3 cp export.tar.gz s3://redwood-prod-exports/acme-poc/2026-03-20/ && sha256sum export.tar.gz > export.sha256
```
ben_se: I'll assemble a one-pager + redacted sample dataset and a Splunk query snippet to demonstrate detection: 
```
index=redwood sourcetype=audit user="alice@acme.com" action="admin.*" | table ts,user,action,request_id
```
omar_security: Add RBAC audit proof: show who can grant admin roles, policy change logs, and MFA enforcement events. I'll include the control owner contact (omar@redwood.com) in the SIG response.
deploy-bot: Export job completed: s3://redwood-prod-exports/acme-poc/2026-03-20/export.tar.gz (manifest: export.sha256)
